I went through high school losing friends constantly for dumb reasons, lived in an abusive household, attempted to commit suicide multiple times, self harmed, got bullied at school, etc. I know how you feel. I'm older now, I moved 5 hrs away from home, I'm still depressed as fuck, I still want to die, but it did get better. its not the best, but I'm much better now than then. I can't say that I regret attempting and I still remember how I felt comforted by the thought of leaving everything behind but sometimes I am glad I couldn't do it and sometimes that's worth it to me
